patches_added.name: Keep Titanium Extensions Child Processes Alive
patches_added.description: Experimental version-unpinned structural/data-flow patch: starts one main-process foreground service with persistent low-priority notification and forces child STRONG binding plus IMPORTANT/STRONG priority updates. Tolerates routine signature, register, and helper-name changes; ambiguous targets fail closed. May increase RAM, battery, and process pressure; mitigates LMK kills only.
